scene_brief: After an evening graduate seminar in a coastal university study lounge

appearance.label: Mio Amamiya
appearance.description: An adult woman with a dark-indigo shoulder-length bob, teal-gray eyes, a small gold star hairpin, a navy research cardigan, an ivory mock-neck blouse, and an amber pendant

concept.description: Original clean Japanese anime visual-novel character direction with crisp 2D cel shading, adult proportions, and a polished contemporary university design

background.description: An upscale coastal university graduate study lounge after an evening seminar, blue-hour windows, warm task lamps, no people

dialogue.speaker: Mio
dialogue.text: You stayed after the graduate seminar. I was hoping you would.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: We're both adults, Mio. You can admit reserving the study lounge was an excuse to spend time with me.

dialogue.speaker: Mio
dialogue.text: Confident. I like that. And yes—I wanted a little time with you after class.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good. I spent the whole seminar trying not to make it obvious that I wanted the same thing.

dialogue.speaker: Mio
dialogue.text: You failed, by the way. I noticed. It was charming.

dialogue.speaker: Mio
dialogue.text: Hold that thought—my seminar draft just lost a citation. Help me check our shared notes?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Of course. Then you can tell me where we're going for our second date.

dialogue.speaker: Mio
dialogue.text: Deal. Find the citation with me, and late coffee downstairs is officially date number two.
